title: Builder Signals · 2026-06-10
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 27 条 X 动态、1 集播客、1 篇博客；本站精选 12 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Swyx · AI Engineer / Cognition / Latent Space 相关建设者
featured.summaryEn: Swyx highlighted METR and Cognition's FrontierCode benchmark, emphasizing that METR found more than half of SWE-bench results to be unmergeable slop. FrontierCode represents 1,000+ hours of maintainer-validated software engineering work, with 3,000+ rubrics covering code quality and anti-cheat reward hacking. He frames the benchmark evolution as three eras: 2021 autocomplete with HumanEval, 2023 passing tests with SWE-bench and TerminalBench, and 2026 maintainable code with FrontierCode; FC Diamond is so hard that…
featured.insightZh: Swyx 这次重点转发并解读了 METR 与 Cognition 相关的 FrontierCode：他强调，METR 发现超过一半 SWE-bench 结果属于“无法合并的 slop”，而 FrontierCode 汇集了 1000+ 小时由维护者验证的软件工程任务，用 3000+ rubrics 覆盖代码质量与反作弊式 reward hacking。他把 AI 编码基准的演进分成三代：2021 年的 autocomplete / HumanEval，2023 年的 passing tests / SWE-bench、TerminalBench，到 2026 年的 maintainable code / FrontierCode；其中 FC Diamond 难到 Opus 4.8 只有 13.8%。

featured.title: Josh Woodward · Google / Google Labs / Gemini App / AI Studio VP
featured.summaryEn: Josh Woodward said NotebookLM's new killer feature is the ability to expand search beyond a user's own source files. With today's update, it can also create new output formats such as PDFs, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and charts. The signal is clear: NotebookLM is moving from source-grounded Q&A toward a fuller research workspace, where the value is not just answering a question but connecting external search, synthesis, and deliverable generation.
featured.insightZh: Josh Woodward 说 NotebookLM 的新 killer feature 是可以把搜索范围扩展到用户自己的 source files 之外，并且今天的更新还支持生成新的输出格式，包括 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX、charts 等。这条信号很清楚：NotebookLM 正在从“基于资料问答”走向更完整的研究工作台，重点不是单次回答，而是把外部搜索、资料整理和可交付物生成串起来。

featured.title: Building an AI Guardian for Enterprise with Onyx Security CEO Maxim Bar Kogan
featured.summaryEn: Enterprises may not be able to stop autonomous agent adoption, but as agent actions grow exponentially, traditional identity, endpoint, API security, and human-in-the-loop controls are not enough to explain why an action happened or whether it was legitimate. That creates a need for specialized AI guardians or secure AI control planes to oversee other AI agents. This No Priors episode interviews Maxim Bar Kogan, CEO of Onyx Security, around a central question: how should enterprise security change when agents stop merely generating text and begin calling APIs, running loops, and taking software actions on behalf of people? Maxim says AutoGPT was the pivotal inspiration. Even though it was too early and the models were not yet good enough, it showed the future structure: an LLM deciding what to do, then using tools to execute. Reasoning models, Claude Code, Cowork, OpenCLO, and other mor…
featured.insightZh: 企业无法阻止 autonomous agents 的采用，但随着 agent actions 指数级增长，传统的 identity、endpoint、API security 和 human-in-the-loop 都不足以解释“这个动作为什么发生、是否合理”，因此需要专门训练的 AI guardian / secure AI control plane 来监督其他 AI agent。 这一期 No Priors 采访 Onyx Security CEO Maxim Bar Kogan，核心问题是：当 agent 不再只是生成文本，而是能调用 API、循环执行、代表人做软件动作时，企业安全应该怎么变化。Maxim 说他们最早被 AutoGPT 启发，因为 AutoGPT 虽然太早、模型还不够好，但展示了“LLM 决定要做什么，再用工具执行”的未来结构。后来 reasoning models、Claude Code、Cowork、OpenCLO 等更 autonomous 的工具出现，市场终于追上了这个判断。 Onyx 的产品定位是训练 models 和构建 agents 去监督其他 agents，并把这种能力产品化成 secure AI control plane：发现企业里的 AI 和 autonomous agents，把它们接入一个系统，用来判断这些 AI actions 是否 legitimate。Maxim 强调，human in the loop 在动作量增长 100x、1000x、甚至 1,000,000x 时不可持续；企业现在也不能简单叫停 adoption，只能降低 agent actions illegitimate 或 incorrect 的概率。 访谈中一个很重要的 enterprise insight 是：传统 permission 模型在 autonomous AI 面前会失效。过去软件系统只给有限权限，出错也只能做权限内的事；但 coding agents 和 assistants 往往需要人的广泛权限，因为用户希望把任务交给它然后离开。…

items.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Boris Cherny reflected on one year since Claude Code's GA. He and Cat Wu discussed how the product changed from the first internal demo reactions on Slack to today's workflows. The concrete signals are useful: why he uses auto mode instead of plan mode, how routines fix bugs before he sees them, why he now does most of his coding from his phone, and where the product is heading next.
items.insightZh: Boris Cherny 回顾 Claude Code GA 一周年：从最早内部 demo 在 Slack 上只有两种反应，到现在他和 Cat Wu 讨论产品一年里的变化。他提到几个具体用法和方向：自己为什么用 auto mode 而不是 plan mode，routines 如何在他看到 bug 前就修掉，为什么现在大部分 coding 都从手机上完成，以及产品接下来会往哪里走。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux posted several lightweight signals about Codex interaction design: asking whether anyone is writing nested loops yet, noting that the image does not make it clear but the “codex dial goes to 11,” and asking whether people would use this controller. The feed does not include the image details, but the direction is visible: the Codex team is exploring more controller- or dial-like interaction metaphors for how developers steer coding agents.
items.insightZh: Thibault Sottiaux 连发几条关于 Codex 交互形态的轻量信号：他问“有人开始写 nested loops 了吗？”，又补充说图里看不清，但 “codex dial goes to 11”，最后问大家是否会使用这个 controller。虽然 feed 里没有图片内容细节，但可以看出 Codex 团队在用更具“控制器 / 旋钮”感的界面隐喻探索开发者如何调节编码代理。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang shared three observations around Codex- and Claude Code-style coding agents. First, he is using Codex on his phone enough to add it to the iPhone Home Screen, while hoping OpenAI makes that easier. Second, he asked what Google's equivalent or emerging competitor to Codex and Claude Code is, whether it might be Antigravity, and argued that coding, knowledge work, basic Q&A, and multi-device access will merge fast. Third, he noted that AI builder best practices may be splitting between subsidized $200/mon…
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 这次围绕 Codex / Claude Code 这类 AI coding agent 提了三个观察：一是他已经“上瘾”到会把 Codex 加到 iPhone 主屏，但也希望 OpenAI 让入口更简单；二是他在问 Google 对标 Codex 和 Claude Code 的产品是什么，是否会是 Antigravity，并判断 ChatGPT / Codex 这种“coding、knowledge work、basic Q&A、任意设备”能力会很快融合；三是他提醒 AI builder 的最佳实践可能正在分化——个人每月 200 美元订阅的玩法，和企业里控制 API 成本的玩法完全不是一套。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Aaron Levie's point is highly relevant to enterprise AI: no amount of raw model intelligence replaces context. The same general-purpose model serves lawyers, engineers, financial analysts, healthcare professionals, and many other roles; as soon as the work becomes specific or differentiated, instructions, domain context, and proprietary data must enter the context window. His conclusion is that AI automation does not come for free: organizations have to do real work to get real value, which is also why applied AI…
items.insightZh: Aaron Levie 的判断很适合企业 AI 场景：无论模型本身有多聪明，都无法替代 context。因为同一个通用模型要服务律师、工程师、金融分析师、医疗专业人员等不同角色，只要任务足够具体、足够差异化，就必须把 instructions、domain context、proprietary data 放进上下文窗口。他的结论是，AI automation 不会“免费发生”；企业要投入真实工作，才能拿到真实价值，而这也解释了 applied AI 和抽象层产品为什么仍然有市场价值。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator President & CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan's posts focused mostly on San Francisco governance and politics. He supported Flock Safety as a way to make cities safer, criticized NIMBYism as impoverishing people, and argued that a new form of centrism is being born in San Francisco—a “common sense Democrat” position emerging from the failures of the hard left. This is not a technical AI signal, but it shows how a YC leader continues to connect the startup ecosystem, public safety, and local politics.
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 今天的几条内容主要集中在旧金山城市治理与政治立场：他支持 Flock Safety，认为其能让城市更安全；批评 NIMBYism 会让普通人更贫困；并称旧金山正在诞生一种新的中间路线，2030 年代会回头看见一种新的 San Francisco common sense Democrat 从 hard left 的失败中出现。这里的技术含量不高，但体现了 YC 领袖持续把创投生态、城市安全和地方政治连接起来表达。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang's posts are about builder craftsmanship. She suggested that the new world might be Markdown, HTML, and SVG, adding that SVG is underrated. She also quoted a line that strongly resonated with her: “I am the programming equivalent of a home cook.” In an AI builder context, the signal is interesting: as more things become AI-generated, lightweight, composable, readable, and editable formats matter more, as does a “home cook” style of personal software practice.
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 的几条内容偏 builder craftsmanship。她认为新的世界可能是 Markdown、HTML、SVG，并特别说 SVG 被低估；另一条则引用一段让她很有共鸣的话：“I am the programming equivalent of a home cook”。这组信号放在 AI builder 语境里很有意思：越多东西被 AI 生成，越需要轻量、可组合、可读可改的表达格式，以及一种“家常厨师式”的个人实践感。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures Partner
items.summaryEn: Nikunj Kothari posted across founders, venture capital, and autonomous companies. He noted that in his conversation with Tai Uti, GTA had a major influence on Tai's career and eventually led to Reactor World. He also joked about founders meeting “thesis driven” GPs only to realize the thesis may have been written by an associate, intern, or someone else. Most relevantly, he observed that many “autonomous” companies have launched recently, but even with all the loops, the last mile remains hard—though that gap may…
items.insightZh: Nikunj Kothari 的几条内容横跨 founder、VC 和 autonomous company。他提到和 Tai Uti 的访谈里，GTA 对其职业路径和最终走向 Reactor World 有很大影响；也调侃 founder 遇到“thesis driven” GP 时，后来发现 thesis 可能是 associate、intern 甚至别人代写的；最后他观察到最近几个月很多“autonomous”公司在启动，但即便有各种 loops，last mile 仍然很难，不过这个 gap 可能会在未来几个月缩小。

items.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
items.summaryEn: Sam Altman posted a short note: “Here is our current plan for OpenAI,” with a link. The feed does not include the linked plan's full text, so this digest does not expand on it. Still, based on engagement, it is one of the day's most watched OpenAI direction-setting posts and is worth opening directly for the full plan.
items.insightZh: Sam Altman 只发了一句：“Here is our current plan for OpenAI”，并附上链接。feed 里没有抓到链接目标的正文，因此这里不展开解读；但从互动量看，这条是当天最受关注的 OpenAI 方向性信息之一，值得直接点开原文看完整计划。

items.title: Building intelligent apps for Apple platforms with Claude in the Foundation Models framework
items.summaryEn: Anthropic released a new Swift package that lets Apple developers call Claude through Apple's Foundation Models framework for more complex workflows. Apple's framework already lets developers access native models from Swift and return typed Swift values through @Generable annotations. Developers can now use on-device models for fast local tasks such as summarization or extraction, then hand off requests that require multi-step reasoning, code generation, web search, or data analysis to Claude. The important point is not merely that Claude is entering the Apple developer ecosystem; it is the task split between on-device models and stronger cloud models. A journaling app can generate daily prompts locally, then ask Claude to find patterns across months of entries. A study app can define a term on-device, then hand off the student's follow-up question—“why does this matter for everything e…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 发布了一个新的 Swift package，让 Apple 开发者可以通过 Apple 的 Foundation Models framework 调用 Claude，处理更复杂的工作流。Apple 的框架本身让开发者能在 Swift 中调用本地模型，并通过 @Generable annotations 返回 typed Swift values；现在开发者可以先用本地模型做快速、私密的 summarization 或 extraction，再把需要 multi-step reasoning、code generation、web search 或 data analysis 的请求交给 Claude。 这篇文章的重点不是“Claude 进了 Apple 生态”这么简单，而是端侧模型与云端强模型的任务分层：journaling app 可以先在本地生成每日提示，再让 Claude 从数月记录里找线索；study app 可以本地解释术语，再把“为什么这对我们学过的其他内容重要”这种追问交给 Claude。Claude support 将通过 iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS 27、visionOS 27 和 watchOS 27 的 Foundation Models framework 提供，开发者加入 package、用 Anthropic API key 登录后，就能把 Apple on-device pass 的 typed outputs 传给 Claude request，并由 package 处理 streaming、tool calls 和 structured responses 回 SwiftUI view。
